event.reason: Read-only request chain; no reachable domain-event producer or mutation trigger. PreviewWorkflowHandoff → applyIssueWorkflow → issueworkflow.ForProject/ForProjectRow → GetProjectInWorkspace, GetIssueWorkflow or DefaultFor/GetDefaultIssueWorkflow; OutsideProject also only reads the default. DefaultFor uses built-in steps on missing rows, never EnsureDefault. Parameters and copied issue are modified in memory. workflowHandoffBrief → workflowBriefInput → status/name lookups; assigneeActiveRuns → ListAssigneeRunsForHandoff. No dispatch or cancellation is called.

Read-only request chain; no reachable domain-event producer or mutation trigger. ListIssueWakeups → workspaceMember → resolveActor → accessibleAgentIDs → ListAllAgents and visibility/invocation-target reads → ListIssueWakeups SQL. SQL joins agent, creator, filter actor and last task; no scheduler synchronization, expiry processing or reconciliation.

Read-only request chain; no reachable domain-event producer or mutation trigger. ListIssueWakeupRuns → GetIssueWakeup; validates workspace and issue ownership → ListWakeupRuns. SQL reads last ten task rows, JSON evidence/check-in note and comment existence; does not check in, trigger or reconcile a run.

Read-only request chain; no reachable domain-event producer or mutation trigger. ListIssueSystemWakeups → listSystemWakeups → childDoneSystemWakeup → status category reads, ListChildIssues, workspace/prefix reads, GetSystemWakeup, optional assignee name reads. Missing rule returns computed workspace defaults and empty ID/revision. No EnsureChildDoneRule, BackfillChildDoneRules, UpdateChildDoneRule or child-event processing is reached.

Read-only request chain; no reachable domain-event producer or mutation trigger. GetActiveTaskForIssue → ListActiveTasksByIssue → taskToResponse → hydrateTaskAttributions → GetUsersByIDs and avatar URL formatting. Query failure becomes empty task list. No runtime refresh, stale-task reconciliation or scheduler sync.

Read-only request chain; no reachable domain-event producer or mutation trigger. ListTasksByIssue validates view/scope/active. family → ListActiveTasksByIssueFamily (cap+1), in-memory summaries and truncation header, immediate return. subtree → ListTasksByIssueSubtree; issue → ListActiveTasksByIssue or ListTasksByIssue. Other paths → visibleTaskHistory/taskToResponse → hydrateTaskSupplementMetadata (ListTaskSupplementMetadata, actor/originator and invocation permission reads only) → hydrateTaskAttributions/GetUsersByIDs. Non-active history → hydrateTaskUsage/ListIssueTaskUsage or hydrateSubtreeTaskUsage/ListTaskUsageByIDs. Subtree → redactHiddenProjectTasks → hiddenProjects and projectaccess.TasksProjects reads; timeline trims response fields in memory. No supplement delivery, usage recording or task-service mutation.
